Safe HTML and iframe basics
Parent page · User input via textContent · sandboxed iframe · Hello · Embedded page · Restricted permissions · Literal text, not markup
Read the diagram step by step

Set textContent for untrusted plain text so markup is not interpreted as HTML. Use a
carefully configured iframe sandbox and restrictive permissions for embeds. A sandbox is
not a substitute for validating content and origins.
